messages:
elena: Heads-up: SKF partner asked for a short checklist for next week's joint perf/W run. Need owners + artifacts (images, kernels, scripts, results upload). Can folks drop what they'll provide? cc @samir @jin @owen

samir: I’ll produce 3 kernel builds: default, nvlink-priority, and power-saver. Will also export perf event list and a build hash. ETA Mon EOD.

jin: I’ll push runtime images: runtime:2.6 and runtime:2.6-quant. Will include a small test harness that runs warmup+steady and emits JSON. Need list of target batch/seq combos.

owen: I can coordinate SI-side integration and get the rack-level power meter MPX serial number so we can match traces to wall-power. Also confirm we can SSH into the host for prometheus scrape.

marcos: Experiment matrix suggestion (short): run_id, date, model, kernel, image_tag, seq, batch, pstate, wall_power_meter, notes. Naming: SKF-2026-<RUNID>-matrix.csv. I’ll create and keep the canonical sheet.

elena: Great. For metrics we agreed: per-GPU power (nvidia-smi), wall power (MPX), GPU util, mem util, avg token-rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, perf counters (SM active, l2_misses). Also KV cache hit rate.

samir: Telemetry quick snippets to include in repo:
```bash
# gpu telemetry (100ms)
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,power.draw,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,clocks.sm --format=csv -lms 100 > /results/gpu.csv &
# wall power via ipmi (poll 500ms)
ipmitool sdr elist | grep MPX || true; while true; do ipmitool sensor get "MPX0"; sleep 0.5; done > /results/wall_power.txt &
# prometheus: scrape local /metrics for runtime counters
```

jin: And run harness example to commit to repo:
```bash
export RUN_ID=skf-${USER}-001
docker run --rm --gpus all -e RUN_ID -e SEQ=512 -e BATCH=2 -v /results:/results ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2.6 ./bench_wrapper.sh --model gptj --tokens 50000
```
Include environment file: bench.env with RUN_ID, SEQ, BATCH, MODEL, IMAGE_TAG.

elena: Ops notes: please do a dry-run in our lab w/ identical rack config before the partner date. If dry-run shows >10% delta from baseline, pause and debug. I’ll draft a 6-step runbook (checkout, build, deploy, measure, upload, validate).

marcos: Can we also capture thermal throttle events and BIOS power caps? Those change perf/W a lot. I’ll record bios settings and FW version.

owen: Partner asked for a short co-announcement window: 2 business days after we approve numbers. Elena, do we want legal looped?

elena: Yes — legal and marketing must approve. No public numbers or social until partner signoff. I’ll own comms template.

samir: I'll add a small postproc script that combines gpu.csv + wall_power.txt + harness JSON -> perf_w.csv and compute avg watts and tokens/s. Will push to tools/bench/postproc.py

bench-bot: Created ticket SKF-5021: "SKF joint perf run - artifacts + runbook". Due Mon.

jin: Last item: dataset & prompt cache — use same seed and prompt set the partner provided. Avoid priming differences. I’ll include prompts.json in artifacts.

elena: Okay owners: samir=kernel builds & perf counters, jin=images + harness + prompts, owen=partner infra & power meter, marcos=matrix + bios notes, elena=comms + runbook. Please upload artifacts to gs://redwood-sf/skf_runs/$RUN_ID and set ACL for partner.

marcos: Quick timeline: dry-run Mon, partner run Wed, analysis Thu-Fri, sync w/partner next Mon. If anything slips ping here.

elena: Thanks all — I’ll post the 6-step runbook and the gsheet link shortly. :rocket:
